items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Well, he had the name of Wunson being a good piano player.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's been kind of not feeling too well. A dog bit his hand. I wanted to use him on piano and some things. I wanted to dream up some stuff.
Well, he had the name of Wunson being a good piano player. There, great bad joint. He's a fine boy.
Let's get the other fellas in the Silver Leaf up. Like, whose place did you take when you went in on trombone?
